'''Pol Tamso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] along with his brother [[Arick Tamso|Arick]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] Pol was stationed at the [[Lower Sundari Outpost]] of the [[Sundari Flatlands]], where he asked a passing Republic citizen to locate Arick at the [[Sundari Research Grounds]] facility, as he had not heard from him for some time.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pol Tamso appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Balmorra, involved in a Heroic quest "Colicoid Massacre."
